Messages.Body:
Learjet: Each time you draw to replace a card this minion played as an
acting minion, you may draw an additional card. Discard down to your
hand size afterward. A minion may have only one vehicle.

Agaitas: Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement from
your prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in
front of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, to be played
or discarded as normal.

With an acting minion with Learjet (Agaitas or with Agaitas
controlled), could I draw 2 cards from my prey's library to replace a
played card?

Thaks a lot

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:


As far as I know, only 1 card may be drawn from your prey's library.
Once you have done that, you've drawn the replacement card, as Agaitas
allows. The additional card you draw from Lear Jet is not the one to
replace the card you just played. It is merely an additional draw.

However, there's nothing to stop you discarding the card you drew from
your prey's library to satisfy the Lear Jet's "discard down to your hand
size" reminder text, thus allowing you to eat up your prey's library,
while still drawing useful cards from your own library.
